test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the pair that is NOT matched correctly (the port to its location).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paradip Port - Puducherry**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Paradip Port** is located in Odisha, not Puducherry.
 
• **Tuticorin Port** is correctly matched with Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Mormugao Port** is correctly matched with Goa.
 
• **Kandla Port** is correctly matched with Gujarat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Paradip Port is one of the major ports on the East Coast of India.
 
• Tuticorin Port, also known as V.O. Chidambaranar Port, is a major port in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Mormugao Port is one of the oldest ports in Goa and plays a significant role in the economy of Goa.
 
• Kandla Port, also known as Deendayal Port, is one of the major ports in western India, situated in Gujarat.
